newsitem.title: UK: Shell says no foreigners held in Nigeria dispute.
newsitem.headline: Shell says no foreigners held in Nigeria dispute.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell Group said on Monday no foreigners were among 126 staff and contractors detained at five oil installations overrun by villagers on the Niger delta at the weekend.
"They are all Nigerian citizens," said a Shell spokesman.
Shell said 12 staff and 77 contractors were being held at its Ewga Two logistics base and another 11 staff and 26 contractors at the Jones Creek pumping station to the west of the Niger river.
Five pumping stations were invaded at the weekend by villagers protesting at the redrawing of local government boundaries.
Six Shell staff and contractors were injured in the attack, during which telecommunications and computer equipment were damaged.
Shell said it was losing 100,000 barrels per day (bpd) of production but would be able to meet all its export commitments for the rest of March.
Shell said it was still trying to reestablish contact with the pumping stations.
